hyperedges.label: Data-Dependent Features
hyperedges.description: All features that display computed data from walks. These are the features affected by aggregation bugs.

hyperedges.label: NaN Safety Fix Chain
hyperedges.description: The chain of fixes that eliminates NaN from reaching the DOM: safeNumber() → aggregateWalks() → dataStore → pages.

hyperedges.label: Three-Layer Architecture
hyperedges.description: The core architectural pattern: domain (pure logic) → infrastructure (persistence) → application (React/Zustand).

nodes.label: Achievement System
nodes.description: 14 badges with XP rewards. Level system. Unlocked on walk completion via checkAchievements().

nodes.label: Activity Rings (Home Dashboard)
nodes.description: 2x2 grid of progress rings for steps, distance, duration, calories. Shows percentage, current value, and goal. Driven by dataStore.todaySnapshot.

nodes.label: Duplicate Aggregation
nodes.description: 5 independent reduce blocks across Home, Track, Stats can disagree on totals.

nodes.label: REQ-001: NaN Safety
nodes.description: All aggregation must use safeNumber(). NaN, undefined, null, Infinity coerce to 0. No NaN reaches DOM.

nodes.label: Personal Records
nodes.description: All-time bests: furthest walk, longest time, most steps, top pace. Shown on Stats page.

nodes.label: Weekly Activity Chart
nodes.description: Bar chart showing distance/steps/duration/calories for last 7 days. Recharts implementation.

nodes.label: dataStore (reactive bridge)
nodes.description: Central Zustand store wrapping the storage adapter. Single source of truth for walks, settings, and all derived values. Replaces direct Dexie calls in lib/db.js and inline aggregation in pages.

nodes.label: localStorageAdapter
nodes.description: Client-side persistence layer with versioned schema, validation, atomic writes, cross-tab sync, and quota handling. API-agnostic interface allows backend swap.

nodes.label: No Validation on Read
nodes.description: Corrupt localStorage data reaches render path without validation.

nodes.label: Streak Tracker
nodes.description: Daily walk streak counter with 7-day visual calendar. Uses calculateStreak() from derivedValues.

nodes.label: REQ-005: Schema Migration
nodes.description: Data from older app versions must load without data loss. Forward migrations.

nodes.label: Schema Versioning
nodes.description: Document has a version field. Migrations run forward from current version. Unrecognised data quarantined, never discarded.

nodes.label: Trust and Honesty Rules
nodes.description: Every displayed value shows provenance, freshness, completeness. Zero vs no-data vs error vs loading are visually distinct. No fake progress, no placeholder numbers.

nodes.label: REQ-003: Validation on Read
nodes.description: Every walk loaded from storage must pass validateWalk(). Corrupt records quarantined.

nodes.label: Data Export/Import
nodes.description: Export walks as JSON. Import from file with merge/replace modes. Backup and migration.

nodes.label: Empty States Design
nodes.description: First run shows encouraging empty state, not error. Each screen has a purpose-built empty state with clear CTA.

nodes.label: Stale Home Data
nodes.description: Home page shows old data after completing a walk until manual refresh.

nodes.label: REQ-006: Graceful Degradation
nodes.description: If localStorage unavailable, app works in memory. User informed.

nodes.label: No Progress Clamping
nodes.description: Individual progress values can exceed 1.0 or be NaN, causing NaN% or Infinity% in DOM.

nodes.label: Legacy Dexie Migration
nodes.description: One-time import from IndexedDB (Dexie) to localStorage. Flag prevents re-run. Original Dexie data preserved.

nodes.label: Infrastructure Layer
nodes.description: Persistence (localStorage adapter), external APIs (Firebase). No React, no page logic.

nodes.label: Walk Summary Screen
nodes.description: Post-walk screen with map, primary stats, secondary stats, elevation chart, achievements, share.

nodes.label: REQ-002: Progress Clamping
nodes.description: Progress values clamped to [0, 1]. Division by zero returns 0.

nodes.label: derivedValues.js (Safe Aggregation)
nodes.description: Pure functions: aggregateWalks(), calculateGoalProgress(), calculateOverallProgress(), countCompletedGoals(). Uses safeNumber() to prevent NaN leaks.

nodes.label: Domain Layer
nodes.description: Pure functions: aggregation, streak, PR, GPS math, calorie/step formulas. No React, no storage, no DOM.

nodes.label: Application Layer
nodes.description: React components, Zustand stores, hooks. May import from domain/ and infrastructure/.

nodes.label: Live GPS Tracking
nodes.description: Real-time walk tracking with map, metrics, auto-pause. Uses trackingStore for ephemeral session state.

nodes.label: Fake Synced Badge
nodes.description: Settings shows Synced badge even when Firebase is not configured.

nodes.label: Missing MapPin Import
nodes.description: Stats.jsx uses MapPin but does not import it. Runtime crash on personal records.

nodes.label: REQ-004: Cross-Tab Consistency
nodes.description: Two open tabs must stay in sync via storage event.

nodes.label: Cross-Tab Sync
nodes.description: Via storage event listener on the adapter. Two tabs write to the same localStorage key; the subscription fires and hydrates both.

nodes.label: Deferred Items
nodes.description: calculateStreak mutation (#4), duration units (#6), 30-day chart (#9), tracking checkpointing, trust rules, accessibility.

nodes.label: Implemented (Phase 4-6)
nodes.description: dataStore created, pages connected, fake badge removed, MapPin fixed, aggregation unified.

nodes.label: Import Rules (Layer Boundaries)
nodes.description: domain/ imports nothing external. infrastructure/ imports domain/. application/ imports domain/, infrastructure/, shared/. shared/ imports nothing.

nodes.label: NaN Aggregation Leak
nodes.description: || 0 guard in reduce blocks catches undefined but not NaN accumulator. One NaN walk poisons all totals.
